recognize_zh: 此抹片可見幾團粉紅色、細絲網狀的物質，上面疊著紅血球輪廓，另有散在的小至中型、核深染、細胞質極少的圓形細胞；在神經母細胞瘤骨髓轉移的背景下，這些網狀物質可對應神經纖維基質（neuropil）或破碎的腫瘤細胞，但本張解析度與染色品質有限，無法明確辨認成團的腫瘤細胞。
features: Several pink, finely fibrillary to lacy aggregates with overlying red cell outlines (neuropil-like material versus smudged/crushed cells)
Scattered small to intermediate round cells with dense hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Occasional normal marrow elements, including a band neutrophil and a cell with distorted nucleus
No cohesive clusters or rosettes clearly identified in this field; arrow points to an area without a distinct cell
Eyepiece photograph with strong pink-yellow cast and blurred detail, limiting interpretation
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered pink fibrillary aggregates with a lacy texture, overlapped by red cells, together with scattered small round cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm and occasional maturing granulocytes. Cohesive tumor clusters or Homer Wright rosettes are not clearly seen in this field, and the color cast and focus limit assessment of chromatin and cytoplasmic detail. The fibrillary material may represent neuropil or crushed tumor cells, but this is not definitive on this image alone. Findings are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, marrow involvement by neuroblastoma; correlation with other fields, biopsy and immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, CD56) is required.

ddx.vs: Smear artifact produces bare nuclear streaks without true fibrillary neuropil or molded tumor clusters, and is common in hypocellular or traumatic aspirates.
Platelet aggregates are granular purple rather than fibrillary pink and lack associated small round tumor cells.
These also form small round blue cell clusters but lack neuropil; distinguished by myogenin/desmin or CD99/NKX2.2 immunostains.
Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without clusters or fibrillary matrix and express TdT/CD19 or CD3 rather than neural markers.
